36.0.en: After long weeks in bed, Lin felt [[negative:negative]] and [[passive:passive]], while grey skies hung low outside.
36.0.zh: 卧床好几个星期之后，林变得消极又被动，窗外灰蒙蒙的天空低低地压着。

36.1.en: His sister Mei stayed [[enthusiastic:enthusiastic]] about slow walks, but Lin felt [[indifferent:indifferent]] to the bright [[spring:spring]] air.
36.1.zh: 妹妹梅对慢慢散步依然热情满满，林却对明朗的春日空气提不起兴趣。

36.2.en: He gave [[apathetic:apathetic]] answers on their short calls, saying his weak legs were a [[negligible:negligible]] issue.
36.2.zh: 简短的电话里，他答得冷冷淡淡，说自己腿软不过是个不值一提的小问题。

36.3.en: Then Grandma's warm soup brought soft [[happiness:happiness]] and [[quiet:quiet]] [[delight:delight]] to his tired heart.
36.3.zh: 后来，奶奶的热汤给他疲惫的心送来了柔软的幸福和安静的喜悦。

36.4.en: A [[merry:merry]] neighbour boy shared short jokes, and clear [[laughter:laughter]] filled the small sunny sitting room.
36.4.zh: 一个欢乐的邻家男孩讲起短笑话，清脆的笑声洒满小小而向阳的客厅。

36.5.en: Lin felt pure [[joy:joy]] again, and his whole family seemed to [[rejoice:rejoice]] with warm tears and smiles.
36.5.zh: 林重新感到纯粹的喜悦，全家人含着热泪微笑，仿佛都在欢庆。

37.0.en: A short walk by the lake gave him a soft [[thrill:thrill]] and an [[agreeable:agreeable]] calm he had long missed.
37.0.zh: 湖边短短一走，给他带来一阵轻柔的兴奋，还有一份久违的舒心平静。

37.1.en: The cool air seemed to [[exhilarate:exhilarate]] him, and his [[first:first]] steps felt easy and [[satisfactory:satisfactory]] after the long rest.
37.1.zh: 凉凉的空气让他浑身振奋，久休之后的第一步走得轻快，令人满意。

37.2.en: Slow [[progress:progress]] felt [[desirable:desirable]] to him, and he grew [[keen:keen]] to learn new skills each bright morning.
37.2.zh: 缓慢的进步也让他觉得称心，每个明朗的早晨他都热切地想学点新本领。

37.3.en: He read old books with fresh [[zeal:zeal]] and joined a [[lively:lively]] little group near the green park.
37.3.zh: 他带着新鲜的热情读旧书，还加入了绿色公园边一个生机勃勃的小组。

37.4.en: Their [[lovely:lovely]] teacher Anna smiled brightly, and Lin grew [[fond:fond]] of her soft stories and songs.
37.4.zh: 他们可爱的老师安娜笑容明亮，林渐渐喜欢上她柔和的故事和歌。

37.5.en: She showed special [[favour:favour]] to slow learners, which gave Lin a [[surprising:surprising]] lift on grey days.
37.5.zh: 她格外偏爱学得慢的孩子，这让林在阴郁的日子里收获了意外的惊喜。

38.0.en: Loud drums at the hall do not [[startle:startle]] him now, though strong voices once used to [[astound:astound]] his weak ears.
38.0.zh: 礼堂里的鼓声如今不再吓到他，虽然从前大嗓门曾让他虚弱的耳朵受不了。

38.1.en: He left his old [[hectic:hectic]] [[routine:routine]] behind and chose a [[liberal:liberal]] plan with plenty of time for rest and books.
38.1.zh: 他告别了从前紧张忙碌的老一套，选了一张宽松的计划表，给休息和读书留足时间。

38.2.en: His uncle Chen was [[generous:generous]] with rice and books, and spoke in a [[gentle:gentle]] low voice on every visit.
38.2.zh: 陈叔叔大方地送米送书，每次来都用低柔温和的声音说话。

38.3.en: Lin stayed [[humble:humble]] about small wins, keeping a [[modest:modest]] notebook of daily steps and meals.
38.3.zh: 林对小小的进步保持谦逊，用一个朴素的本子记下每天的步数和饭食。

38.4.en: Ben told [[humorous:humorous]] tales at lunch, and Lin answered in a [[polite:polite]] way with a bright grin.
38.4.zh: 本在午饭时讲幽默故事，林咧嘴一笑，很有礼貌地回应。

38.5.en: Mei was always [[frank:frank]] with Lin, while the old maps on the wall looked [[mysterious:mysterious]] and fun to study.
38.5.zh: 梅对林一向坦率，墙上的旧地图则显得神秘又有趣，值得好好研究。

39.0.en: Lin grew [[curious:curious]] about the stars and felt [[daring:daring]] enough to ask hard questions in class.
39.0.zh: 林对星星生出好奇，也鼓起勇气，敢在课上大胆提出难问题。

39.1.en: His father praised the [[manly:manly]] courage it took to keep walking, and gave him clear, [[direct:direct]] tips for safe breathing.
39.1.zh: 父亲夸他有男子气概，能坚持走路，还给了他直接清楚的安全呼吸小窍门。

39.2.en: With an [[earnest:earnest]] face, Lin promised to practise daily, and his words carried simple [[honesty:honesty]] and warmth.
39.2.zh: 林一脸认真地保证每天练习，话语里透着质朴的诚实和暖意。

39.3.en: Anna felt [[proud:proud]] of him and stayed [[rational:rational]] under [[pressure:pressure]].
39.3.zh: 安娜为他感到自豪，压力之下也始终保持理性。

39.4.en: The [[host:host]] of the reading group was [[hospitable:hospitable]] and spoke [[seriously:seriously]] about life.
39.4.zh: 读书会的主人热情好客，还认真地和大家聊起生活。

39.5.en: They cherished their [[freedom:freedom]] and pursued their [[romantic:romantic]] dreams together.
39.5.zh: 他们珍视自己的自由，也一起追寻浪漫的梦想。

40.0.en: Small wins built up his [[confidence:confidence]], and he grew more [[considerate:considerate]] toward old neighbours on the stairs.
40.0.zh: 小小的胜利一点点垒起他的信心，他对楼梯上的老邻居也更体贴了。

40.1.en: Anna wrote [[thoughtful:thoughtful]] notes in the margins, and classmates stayed [[sympathetic:sympathetic]] whenever Lin walked slowly.
40.1.zh: 安娜在页边写下体贴的批注，林走得慢的时候，同学们也始终体谅他。

40.2.en: The doctor showed real [[mercy:mercy]] to the tired boy after his fall, and Lin began to [[admire:admire]] the nurses who work through long evenings.
40.2.zh: 他摔倒之后，医生对这个疲惫的男孩格外宽厚，林也开始敬佩那些熬过漫长夜晚的护士。

40.3.en: His birthday [[sketch:sketch]] of the lake looked [[remarkable:remarkable]], and Lin felt deeply [[grateful:grateful]] for the hands that had held him up.
40.3.zh: 他画的那张湖泊生日速写相当出色，林也深深感激那些曾把他扶起来的手。

40.4.en: He wrote a letter of [[gratitude:gratitude]] to Anna, saying he felt [[eager:eager]] to start a new year of learning.
40.4.zh: 他给安娜写了一封感谢信，说自己热切盼望开启新的一年学习。

40.5.en: The doctor called his lungs [[sound:sound]] and strong, and praised the [[picturesque:picturesque]] path where Lin walks every day.
40.5.zh: 医生说他的肺很健全强健，还夸他天天散步的那条小路风景如画。

41.0.en: His [[test:test]] scores look [[promising:promising]] this [[spring:spring]], and Anna hangs his essay in a [[prominent:prominent]] place on the wall.
41.0.zh: 今年春天他的考试成绩颇有希望，安娜把他的作文贴在墙上显眼的地方。

41.1.en: The [[mountain:mountain]] view from the clinic roof feels [[awesome:awesome]], though climbing those steps was [[arduous:arduous]] last winter.
41.1.zh: 从诊所屋顶望出去的山景令人惊叹，虽然去年冬天爬那些台阶十分艰辛。

41.2.en: Lin finishes a [[tough:tough]] set of stairs, and his legs feel more [[robust:robust]] than in the cold rainy weeks.
41.2.zh: 林走完一段难走的楼梯，双腿比阴雨连绵的那些周更加强健了。

41.3.en: He buys [[sturdy:sturdy]] shoes for his walks, and Mei stays [[steadfast:steadfast]] beside him through wind and light rain.
41.3.zh: 他买了结实的走路鞋，无论刮风还是细雨，梅都坚定地陪在他身边。

41.4.en: Grandma cooks [[tender:tender]] vegetables with soft rice, keeping the meals [[temperate:temperate]] and light for his weak [[stomach:stomach]].
41.4.zh: 奶奶煮了软嫩的青菜配软饭，饭菜温和清淡，正好顾着他娇弱的胃。

41.5.en: His [[paper:paper]] birds look [[delicate:delicate]] and bright, turning [[mundane:mundane]] grey afternoons into games for the kids.
41.5.zh: 他的纸鸟精致又鲜亮，把平淡无奇的灰色午后变成了孩子们的游戏。

42.0.en: His [[first:first]] questions seem [[naive:naive]] and [[childish:childish]], but Anna praises his brave will to learn more.
42.0.zh: 他最初的那些问题显得天真又孩子气，安娜却夸他有一股想要多学的勇气。

42.1.en: Lin gives a [[sincere:sincere]] smile to his helpers, knowing he is still [[liable:liable]] to [[slip:slip]] on wet stones.
42.1.zh: 林对帮过他的人报以真诚的微笑，心里明白自己在湿石板上还是容易打滑。

42.2.en: Ben proves a [[trustworthy:trustworthy]] study friend, and he is [[enterprising:enterprising]] enough to plan a sale of [[paper:paper]] birds.
42.2.zh: 本证明了自己是值得信赖的学习伙伴，他还颇有闯劲，盘算着把纸鸟拿去义卖。

42.3.en: Lin keeps [[sane:sane]] hours of sleep, avoiding [[strenuous:strenuous]] late tasks that leave him pale and worn.
42.3.zh: 林保持着明智的睡眠时间，避开那些让他脸色苍白、精疲力竭的熬夜苦活。

42.4.en: Anna sets [[rigorous:rigorous]] reading goals, with [[strict:strict]] rules about phones during [[quiet:quiet]] study time.
42.4.zh: 安娜定下缜密的阅读目标，安静自习时对手机的管理也很严格。

42.5.en: The winter cough was [[severe:severe]], but [[spring:spring]] brings [[mutual:mutual]] help between Lin and his old friends.
42.5.zh: 冬天的咳嗽曾很严重，但春天带来了林和老朋友之间的互相扶持。

43.0.en: His sketches begin to [[resemble:resemble]] real trees, using [[similar:similar]] lines to the ones he copied from Anna's old book.
43.0.zh: 他的速写开始像真的树了，线条跟安娜旧书上的如出一辙。

43.1.en: The lake path feels [[familiar:familiar]] every morning, even with the trees [[naked:naked]] of leaves in the early [[spring:spring]] wind.
43.1.zh: 湖边小路每个早晨都那么熟悉，哪怕早春的风里树木还光秃秃的。

43.2.en: Lin keeps his feet [[bare:bare]] on the warm sand, and loves the [[private:private]] calm behind the tall green reeds.
43.2.zh: 林光着脚踩在暖沙上，最爱高高芦苇后面那份只属于他的安静。

43.3.en: His quick [[intuition:intuition]] for tunes grows, and he sings a [[spontaneous:spontaneous]] soft song for Grandma's birthday.
43.3.zh: 他对旋律的直觉越来越强，还为奶奶的生日即兴唱了一首柔柔的歌。

43.4.en: Anna's [[praise:praise]] carries an [[implicit:implicit]] push to try more, not an [[illusion:illusion]] of quick, easy success.
43.4.zh: 安娜的夸奖里藏着让人再试一试的推力，而不是一夜轻松成功的幻象。

43.5.en: Lin draws an [[imaginary:imaginary]] green island, and the kids love his bright [[paper:paper]] boats and [[fancy:fancy]] flags.
43.5.zh: 林画了一座想象中的绿岛，孩子们都喜欢他鲜亮的纸船和花哨的小旗。

44.0.en: He no longer blames [[fate:fate]] for his [[illness:illness]], but thanks his good [[fortune:fortune]] and his family's full care.
44.0.zh: 他不再埋怨命运让自己生病，而是感谢好运，也感谢家人无微不至的照顾。

44.1.en: The old leg [[agony:agony]] has eased, though Lin still recalls the deep [[grief:grief]] of his lonely days in bed.
44.1.zh: 腿上旧日的剧痛已经缓解，可林仍记得卧床那些孤独日子里的深深悲伤。

44.2.en: He does not [[grieve:grieve]] long over lost games, refusing to stay [[miserable:miserable]] while his friends wait [[outside:outside]].
44.2.zh: 输了比赛他也不会伤心太久，不愿在朋友们在外面等候时还闷闷不乐。

44.3.en: Past alarms at the clinic caused sharp [[distress:distress]], but music softened the old [[sadness:sadness]] on rainy afternoons.
44.3.zh: 从前诊所的警报声曾带来剧烈的惊惶，音乐却在下雨的午后抚平了旧日的悲伤。

44.4.en: On [[gloomy:gloomy]] grey days Lin refuses to [[disappoint:disappoint]] Anna, finishing his page with slow care.
44.4.zh: 在阴沉灰暗的日子里，林也不肯让安娜失望，总是一笔一画慢慢写完那一页。

44.5.en: Cold rain cannot [[discourage:discourage]] him, though wet shoes once left him feeling [[wretched:wretched]] and worn.
44.5.zh: 冷雨浇不垮他，虽然有一次鞋子湿透，让他又狼狈又疲惫。

45.0.en: It is [[frustrating:frustrating]] to [[miss:miss]] matches, but Lin will not [[mourn:mourn]] lost goals beside the river.
45.0.zh: 错过比赛固然让人泄气，但林不会坐在河边，为那些没进的球哀伤。

45.1.en: His old [[anger:anger]] at the slow healing has faded, and Lin is no longer [[furious:furious]] about the school trips he missed.
45.1.zh: 对康复太慢的怒气已渐渐散去，他也不再为错过的学校远足而暴怒。

45.2.en: Anna's calm smile smooths away his [[frown:frown]], and teaches him to meet delays without [[inner:inner]] [[rage:rage]] or shouts.
45.2.zh: 安娜平静的微笑抚平了他的皱眉，也教他不憋闷火、不喊不叫地面对耽搁。

45.3.en: Noisy buses no longer seem to [[irritate:irritate]] him, and he refuses to [[hate:hate]] his slow [[progress:progress]] on the stairs.
45.3.zh: 吵闹的公交车似乎再也惹不恼他，他也不去恨楼梯上那点缓慢的进步。

45.4.en: He lets go of his [[hatred:hatred]] for long delays, seeing flies as a small [[nuisance:nuisance]], not a big [[deal:deal]].
45.4.zh: 他放下了对久等的憎恨，把飞虫只当成小小的麻烦，而不是什么大不了的事。

45.5.en: The [[bitter:bitter]] soup puts no look of [[disgust:disgust]] on his face, and late buses never [[vex:vex]] his even mood.
45.5.zh: 发苦的汤没让他脸上露出一丝嫌弃，晚点的公交车也扰乱不了他平和的心情。

46.0.en: He asks the kids not to [[harass:harass]] the weak ducks, nor to [[bother:bother]] the old cats sleeping by the wall.
46.0.zh: 他请孩子们别去骚扰那些瘦弱的鸭子，也别去打扰在墙边睡觉的老猫。

46.1.en: [[muddy:Muddy]] shoes feel [[troublesome:troublesome]] after rain, but never as [[awful:awful]] as those lonely weeks in bed.
46.1.zh: 雨后的泥鞋子让人心烦，却远不如独自卧床的那几个星期难受。

46.2.en: Even the [[unpleasant:unpleasant]] [[medicine:medicine]] lines move fast, despite the [[adverse:adverse]] wind rattling the clinic windows.
46.2.zh: 连令人不快的取药长队也走得飞快，尽管不利的风把诊所的窗户吹得咔咔作响。

46.3.en: No neighbour looks [[hostile:hostile]] now, and Lin never feels [[indignant:indignant]] about short waiting lines.
46.3.zh: 如今没有一个邻居面带敌意，队伍不长的时候林也从不会愤愤不平。

46.4.en: Anna suggests a [[radical:radical]] new reading [[list:list]], not a [[mad:mad]] rush through ten books in one week.
46.4.zh: 安娜建议了一份大胆全新的阅读书单，而不是一周十本的疯狂赶读。

46.5.en: Wild and [[crazy:crazy]] games on the wet rocks are banned, along with [[wicked:wicked]] tricks that [[hurt:hurt]] the small kids.
46.5.zh: 湿石头上又野又疯的游戏被禁止了，那些弄伤小孩子的恶毒把戏也不许再玩。

47.0.en: No stray dog bites in a [[vicious:vicious]] way, and the boys avoid [[vulgar:vulgar]] shouts across the [[quiet:quiet]] lake.
47.0.zh: 没有流浪狗凶狠地咬人，男孩们也不隔着安静的湖面喊粗话。

47.1.en: No kid writes a [[mean:mean]] note, and Lin keeps his growing [[ego:ego]] in check with daily chores.
47.1.zh: 没有孩子写刻薄的纸条，林则靠每天做家务，管住自己渐渐膨胀的自负。

47.2.en: He refuses the [[selfish:selfish]] wish to keep all the paints, and shares no [[nasty:nasty]] words with slow partners.
47.2.zh: 他拒绝了独吞所有颜料的自私念头，也从不跟动作慢的伙伴说难听的话。

47.3.en: Lin avoids a [[rash:rash]] [[dash:dash]] across the road, learning to settle his [[volatile:volatile]] mood after [[steep:steep]] climbs.
47.3.zh: 林不再冒冒失失地冲过马路，也学着在爬完陡坡之后，让起伏不定的心情平复下来。

47.4.en: [[weird:Weird]] dreams fade by [[sunrise:sunrise]], and he [[quit:quits]] the [[excessive:excessive]] late snacks that [[hurt:hurt]] his sleep.
47.4.zh: 怪异的梦在天亮时散去，他也戒掉了伤害睡眠的过量夜宵。

47.5.en: Old [[anxiety:anxiety]] about the tests returns, leaving Lin [[restless:restless]] in his chair till lunch.
47.5.zh: 对考试的旧焦虑又回来了，让林坐在椅子上坐立难安，一直到午饭时分。

paraZh.36: 久病消沉遇暖意，笑声热汤唤回喜悦。
paraZh.37: 湖边迈开第一步，学习热情重燃。
paraZh.38: 告别忙碌择宽松，亲友厚爱伴左右。
paraZh.39: 敢问敢练得夸奖，读书会里真诚相聚。
paraZh.40: 信心渐长懂感恩，感谢信致敬安娜。
paraZh.41: 成绩向好腿脚健，纸鸟点亮灰色午后。
paraZh.42: 问题天真勇气可嘉，作息规律目标严格。
paraZh.43: 画技渐长歌兴起，湖畔静谧滋养想象。
paraZh.44: 不再怨命感恩家人，风雨不改其志。
paraZh.45: 输球不哀怒气消，苦汤晚车不动心。
paraZh.46: 护鸭护猫守规矩，新读书单贵在从容。
paraZh.47: 管住自负戒零食，考前焦虑又敲门。
